meaning: Optical or SAR-side evidence supports that a vehicle-like object may exist in the reviewed window
upgrade_requirement: Independent SAR-internal vehicle-like evidence plus permission gate

meaning: Evidence supports preserving a different-vehicle or context-only boundary
allowed_use: Boundary protection and conservative graph blocking
upgrade_requirement: Explicit independent boundary evidence in later protocol if relaxation is considered
notes: Boundary support can be a positive result

meaning: Optical state or SAR morphology explains why expected support may shift or expand
allowed_use: Mechanism diagnosis and future review planning
forbidden_use: adjust runtime prior or final box

meaning: Temporal or morphology evidence explains a missing optical detection or weak observation
forbidden_use: automatic recovery of labels or boxes
upgrade_requirement: Independent SAR-internal temporal support plus optical gap audit
notes: Do not mix into clean paired morphology

meaning: Optical evidence shows visible vehicle context not captured by current box stream
allowed_use: Failure diagnosis and object-stream recovery planning
forbidden_use: create revised annotation or final box
upgrade_requirement: Later optical review and SAR-internal evidence if used
notes: Gap explanation is not a new annotation

meaning: Evidence shows multi-vehicle or multi-target competition
allowed_use: Block identity upgrade and prioritize competitor review
forbidden_use: force one-to-one mapping or choose winner
upgrade_requirement: Independent separation evidence in later protocol
notes: Competition is not noise to average away

meaning: SAR or optical context suggests background or static reflector risk
allowed_use: Weaken mechanism claim and require rejection logic
notes: Negative logic is required for closure

meaning: Evidence is suggestive but limited to posthoc support
allowed_use: Review hint and mechanism vocabulary only
forbidden_use: SAR consumption upgrade or identity claim
upgrade_requirement: Independent SAR-internal evidence plus stronger optical boundary status
notes: Default for weak optical threads with overlap

meaning: Available sources do not support a mechanism relation
allowed_use: Block upgrade and record missing evidence
forbidden_use: fill with assumptions or inferred identity
upgrade_requirement: Required source recovery or visual evidence
blocking_conditions: missing direct azimuth source;missing SAR reference candidate
example_wgv_source: GM_RM011 direct azimuth source missing in WGV1.7

meaning: Evidence conflicts with the proposed relation
allowed_use: Stop relation and route to review or redesign
forbidden_use: resolve by scoring or weighted fusion
upgrade_requirement: Contradiction-specific evidence audit and later protocol

meaning: Relation may look plausible but provenance forbids the use
forbidden_use: consume as runtime prior or annotation
upgrade_requirement: New protocol that changes permission with evidence
blocking_conditions: posthoc SAR evidence used as proof;weak thread upgraded
example_wgv_source: GM_RM017 posthoc overlap cannot upgrade weak identity

meaning: Known boundary or context-only edge prevents same-vehicle relation
allowed_use: Preserve edge as boundary and block bridge
forbidden_use: relax boundary by color or temporal overlap
upgrade_requirement: Independent boundary evidence plus later protocol
notes: Boundary block remains even if nearby evidence exists

meaning: Identity risk is too high for consumption or upgrade
allowed_use: Block SAR consumption and graph relation upgrade
upgrade_requirement: Strong independent evidence and explicit review protocol
